svg.title: Scrutate: instant search with no index, code intelligence from an index
svg.desc: Lines 10 to 19 of src/files.rs (scrutate's own source, crates/scrutate at 06553bc), and four searches run over them with scrutate 0.1.0, one after another: `-F index_dir src` marks 1 on these lines and reports 6 matching lines in 4 of 29 files; `--ident indexDir src` marks 3 on these lines and reports 17 matching lines in 8 of 29 files; `--fuzzy=1 dirctory src` marks 3 on these lines and reports 125 matching lines in 15 of 29 files; `"root\.\w+" src` marks 4 on these lines and reports 207 matching lines in 15 of 29 files. Each search is typed, a reticle finds each match the binary reported, a highlighter marks it and the counts run up to the real numbers. Above: the wordmark SCRUTATE, whose A has a highlighter stroke for its bar, and the lines 'Instant search, no index. Code intelligence from an index. Two engines, one Rust binary.'. With reduced motion the searches still run; the reticle and the wordmark stand still.
svg.text: /// Where the indexes live under the repository
directory and nothing the indexes write into is
/// a symbolic link (which would put the index,
and its deletions, outside the repository).
